parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries an empty `members` array and all structural evidence fields (`differing_slots`, `jaccard`, `shared_field_count`, `shared_ancestor`) are null. Without field lists, method signatures, or context flags for either `Deque` in `Shared/Core/Sources/Core/Deque.swift` or `Queue` in `Shared/PartyHorn/Sources/PartyHorn/Queue.swift`, there is no grounded evidence on which to base an actionable refactor recommendation. Recommending any structural change — such as extracting a common protocol or lifting shared members — would require inventing evidence not present in the cluster row, which is prohibited. The subset-pairs signal alone, absent supporting field data, is insufficient to distinguish a meaningful overlap from a coincidental shape match between a double-ended queue and a single-ended queue.
